purpose: Test whether single-pass locally learned, publicly filtered two-state predictive memory captures useful history more economically than batch EM while preserving independent controls.

hypotheses.H1: The online local belief learner improves next-bit NLL over its frozen-dynamics ablation in both causal families.
hypotheses.H2: Online local belief learner's NLL is competitive with batch-EM HMM and fitted counts while using strictly less CPU for fit+selection than the batch-EM comparator; resource advantage requires both metrics and no hidden memory omission.
hypotheses.null: No spurious causal-state advantage is claimed from iid-null.

allowed_public_history: Sequential current observation, current action, prior public observations/actions for predicting next public observation; no hidden state, future signal, privileged family label.

ONLINE_LOCAL_BELIEF.state_memory: two-state Bayesian posterior updated on public next observation
ONLINE_LOCAL_BELIEF.learning: local soft-state emission and action-conditioned transition updates; no hidden label

ONLINE_FROZEN_TRANSITION_ABLATION.same_parameterization: same online learner, same emitted input, training steps and initializations

development_decision.metric: next-public-bit mean Bernoulli negative log likelihood nats/bit
development_decision.primary_comparison: online versus the strongest fitted conventional among BATCH_HMM_EM_O4, PUBLIC_CURRENT_COUNTS, PUBLIC_LAG_COUNTS on A and B separately
development_decision.ablation_comparison: online versus frozen-transition on A and B separately
development_decision.cpu_comparison: online vs batch HMM using full fit+model-selection CPU, shared native OS; separately report source generation and inference
resource_accounting: fit and selection CPU each arm
development_decision.no_positive_claim_without: predeclared gain and cost comparisons corroborated on both OS; source-only public result cannot constitute SCIENTIFIC_GO
development_decision.if_negative: retain all signed loss and no integration
development_decision.cross_os_require: exact matching TRAIN/SELECT/DEV digests by family, all NLLs absolute difference <=1e-6

constraints: O4 results never used for O5 model selection, parameter tuning or reanalysis.
No Q20/Q21/Q21N01 roles, protected original/HELD or FSA dispatch.
Original O4 fixed model source copied byte-exact, not modified.
Adversarial source-only tests, no hidden source generator inside learner.
A synthetic source does not establish independent unusual-task transfer.
No paid API, new controller, extra queue, live D1 mutation, KTRADE or private CKB dependency.
Do not merge draft until independent full regression and source qualification.
future: If useful, prospectively contrast independent new source-family physics, stronger fully FIT-trained predictive/recurrent comparators, input-intervention ablations, long-term retention and matched full cost, before Wingless/Yggdrasil candidate integration.
